name: @loxaic/desktop
description: Loxaic — a self-hosted, multi-user AI platform, packaged with its own server and database.

scripts.package: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:tsnet-proxy && pnpm build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:publish: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:tsnet-proxy && pnpm build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.package:dir: mkdir -p resources/tsnet-proxy && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
